name: Scripts & chaining (JSONPlaceholder)
description:
A fake blog API from [JSONPlaceholder](https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com). Writes are simulated: the server answers as if it saved them.

The requests pass data along with scripts: **List posts** saves the first post's id in `postId`, and the next requests use `{{postId}}`. Run the collection in order to see it (right-click ▸ **Run collection**). **Posts as a table** draws the response with `pm.visualizer` (open the **Visualize** tab of the response).
preRequestScript:
// runs before every request in this collection
pm.variables.set('requestedAt', new Date().toISOString());

items.name: List posts of a user
Get the post
items.testScript: pm.test('it is the post we asked for', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('postId'))));

items.name: Posts as a table (Visualizer)
